summary: charge_confusion_rate.py template mode reported status ok with no warning for bins whose fit had a covariance warning or a yield at the boundary; its failed test on a missing rate_error could never fire.

impact.bias: no number changes; bins with fit_outcome covariance-warning or converged-at-boundary carried no warning (rate_error_hessian unreliable there), seen in 10 runs at 5e5 to 1e6 events per bin
impact.trigger: template-mode output whose bins show fit_outcome covariance-warning or converged-at-boundary with an empty warnings list

outputs.how_to_recognize: JSON on stdout of charge_confusion_rate.py template: status ok, warnings [], and a bin with fit_outcome other than converged; no artifact records the run

remedy: check fit_outcome of every bin in existing outputs; rerun on a version with the fix to get the warnings
